{{Quote|This is Harro Ruuk, Trade Federation Regional Commander of the Karthakk system. Turn back or you will be fired upon!|Harro Ruuk to [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
The '''Attack on the Trade Federation Sensor Station''' was led by Nym and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] to take out the [[Trade Federation Sensor Station]] that had been following their every move for the past ten years.

==Prelude==
The pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his band were attacking [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] shipping in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] before losing their base in an attack. They would spent the next ten years on the run. After joining up with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and the [[Revenant (Mere)|Revenants]], Nym could go on the offensive once again.

==The battle==
The attack was staged in the air and sea with [[Sol Sixxa]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orsai]] in command of 2 [[Demolition Boat]]s loaded with explosives receiving air support from Nym, [[Jinkins]], Reti and Adi Gallia. The passage to the Sensor Station was littered with [[mines]] and [[Tractor beam/Legends|Tractor]] Towers. The group was also stymied by the arrival of [[Trade Federation droid bomber|bombers]], [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Trade Federation submarine|Trade Federation U-boat]]s.

Once the group negotiated their way around the various islands and traps they came to the Sensor Station itself and were greeted by a warning from [[Harro Ruuk]], The Trade Federation regional [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Karthakk system]]. Sol Sixxa then infiltrated the base and set explosive charges that destroyed the Station once and for all. Ruuk then surfaced in a [[Crab Submarine|crab submarine]] and engaged Nym, who promptly destroyed the submarine.

==Aftermath==
Nym and the group would then depart for coordinates that led to [[Mount Merakan]] to investigate the Federation's interest in the area. Ruuk would escape via escape pod and dock with a local [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk-class battleship]] where he would be killed by a vile of [[trihexalon]] after [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cavik Toth]] became most displeased with his apparent lack of progress.

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based on the mission "Turning the Tides" in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''. The player flies as Nym in his personal starfighter.
